result.instructions: Tools for Zylvie, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which active coupons have been redeemed most often?"; "Show succeeded transactions for this month."; "List active subscriptions scheduled to cancel.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zylvie data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zylvie_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zylvie_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zylvie_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. zylvie_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zylvie_get_account
tools.title: Get authenticating account
tools.description: Authenticating account email and brand. Billing identity is per API key, not this email or brand. Read-only.

tools.name: zylvie_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: All active coupons, or archived coupons when archived is true, with discount terms and redemption counts. This list is not paginated. Read-only.

tools.name: zylvie_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: Transaction amounts, payment/refund status, buyer name/email and product summaries, newest first. Amounts are in major currency units; refunded false can include partial refunds. Excludes addresses, phone/card/bank details and custom fields. Read-only.

status.description: Payment/subscription status; vendor values are open-ended.

tools.name: zylvie_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: Subscription status, amount, cancellation/trial dates, product and buyer name/email, newest first. Amounts are major currency units, unlike the separate verify-subscription API. An active subscription may have cancel_at set. Excludes addresses, phone/card/bank details and custom fields. Read-only.

status.description: Payment/subscription status; vendor values are open-ended.
